Substituting $(x - 2)(x + 4)(x - 5)$ for $h(x)$ yields $g(x) = (x - 2)(x + 4)(x - 5) + 7$. For the point $(6, c)$, the value of $x$ is $6$. Substituting $6$ for $x$ gives $g(6) = (6 - 2)(6 + 4)(6 - 5) + 7$, which simplifies to $g(6) = (4)(10)(1) + 7 = 40 + 7 = 47$. Therefore, the value of $c$ is $47$.
